experiments.label: Baseline
experiments.problem: 35/120 cases output nothing at all — pipeline never reached the rules checker.

experiments.label: Exp 1
experiments.problem: Gate 2 required lab/notes fields that weren't in the data — 35 cases escalated before reaching the rules checker.

experiments.label: Exp 2
experiments.change: Gate 4: admin fields OK (DOB/NPI placeholders accepted)
experiments.problem: Gate 4 penalised missing DOB/NPI/group fields even though synthetic data omits them by design — 22 remaining UNKNOWN cases stuck here.
experiments.notes: 0 UNKNOWN; 0 Escalated. All 120 cases produce decisions.

experiments.label: Exp 3b
experiments.problem: GPT-4o-mini supervisors lacked the reasoning depth to validate clinical determinations reliably. Sets the operational baseline for all subsequent experiments.
experiments.notes: 7× cost spike; −10s latency. Sets GPT-4o supervisor baseline.

experiments.label: Exp 4
experiments.change: Rules Checker: strict JSON-only mode, no hallucinations
experiments.problem: Rules Checker was hallucinating requirements not in insurer_rules.json and issuing DENIED on missing data instead of NEEDS_MORE_INFO. First experiment measurable by exact_match.

experiments.label: Exp 5
experiments.change: Gate 3: accept NMI as valid terminal decision
experiments.problem: Gate 3 rubric penalised NEEDS_MORE_INFO as 'unclear logic' — correct NMI outputs were being rejected by the supervisor, suppressing the score. Fix unblocked NMI but over-indexed: 114/120 cases became NMI.

experiments.label: Exp 6d.1
experiments.problem: LLM couldn't distinguish 'data missing → NMI' from 'data present but criteria not met → DENIED'. Adding Python-first rules for clear cases (contraindications, lab failures, step therapy) removed the ambiguity before the LLM ran.
experiments.notes: Best ROI code change. Python-first, zero LLM tokens on clear cases.

experiments.label: Exp 7
experiments.problem: 32 gold labels in pa-baseline-120-apr08 were wrong — model was correct but scored as wrong. Audit found these were dataset alignment errors, not model errors. Score gain reflects benchmark quality, not model improvement.
experiments.notes: Dataset alignment. DENIED→NMI: 24 remain dominant error.

experiments.label: Exp 8
experiments.change: RULE 4A + supervisor wiring fix (partial failure → DENIED)
experiments.problem: Partial step therapy failure (some drugs done, not all) was being output as NMI instead of DENIED. RULE 4A taught the model: data present + criteria not met = DENIED. Supervisor wiring fixed decision propagation.

experiments.label: Exp 9
experiments.problem: 9 further gold label mismatches identified post-Exp 8. Step-therapy sequence check added to handle ordering edge cases. DENIED→NMI (24 cases, zero prior treatments) identified as next dominant error — targeted in Exp 10.

experiments.label: Exp 10
experiments.problem: 24 cases with prior_treatments=[] were output as NMI — model treated empty list as 'missing data'. Fix: if no step therapy documented at all, that IS the answer — step therapy not done → DENIED. Run contaminated by API quota exhaustion.
experiments.notes: CONTAMINATED: −18 quota kills, −4 over-deny, −8 LLM regressions. 18/18 target cases row-confirmed fixed. Projected clean: 78–82%.
